patches.title: Animation & studio update
items: New size-normalization pipeline: heroes render at a consistent size with no bouncing across every clip.
Role-based battlefield sizing — tanks are largest, backline mages smallest.
Fritz, Aureth, and Vireo animations rebuilt and cleaned up.
Xanthyr Games branding + studio logo added.

patches.title: Terms & accounts
items: Added a first-sign-in Terms of Service acceptance step.
Cloud accounts: sign in and sync progress across devices.
Installable app support (add Emberweave to your home screen).
